snippet.title: Do A Crime - Steam Next Fest: February 2026 Demo
snippet.description:
Do A Crime is a casually-chaotic-cozy platform puzzler where you play as a Raccoon - doing crimes! Do A Crime takes the whimsy of being a mischievous raccoon and allows the you to live out your chaos gremlin dreams.

Play as Lil' Bud, a mischievous raccoon, as they rampage through the junkyard, city park, and beyond in the hopes to stop Mayor Crowe from turning his home into a parking lot. Leap between platforms, stack blocks to reach new places, and commit crimes to complete your criminal record and find your way to the Mayor!

Developed by Collywobble Games
Release Date: 2026
